This video covers The Hindu Editorial published on October 29, 2026, titled "Clinging on: On Netanyahu and the Israel elections."
With 85.6% of the votes counted in Israel’s October 27 elections, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s right-religious coalition has lost its majority, though Likud remains the single largest party with a projected 26 seats. Former military chief Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party is expected to win 21 seats, while far-right allies Otzma Yehudit and Religious Zionism secured 13 seats combined.
